verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הַשֵּׁנִי֙ לְשִׁמְע֔וֹן לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיְהִי֙ נַֽחֲלָתָ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hag·gō·w·rāl haš·šê·nî lə·šim·‘ō·wn lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- šim·‘ō·wn lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām way·hî na·ḥă·lā·ṯām bə·ṯō·wḵ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: The second lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Simeon - Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah
verses.literalPt: Saiu a segunda sorte a Simeão, isto é, a tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo as suas famílias; e a sua herança foi no meio da dos filhos de Judá.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּנַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם בְּאֵֽר־ שֶׁ֥בַע וְשֶׁ֖בַע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·hem bə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯām bə·’êr- še·ḇa‘ wə·še·ḇa‘ ū·mō·w·lā·ḏāh
verses.literal: and included Beersheba (or Sheba) Moladah
verses.literalPt: Receberam por sua herança: Berseba, ou Seba, Moladá,

verses.original: וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבָלָ֖ה וָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·ṣar šū·‘āl ū·ḇā·lāh wā·‘ā·ṣem
verses.literal: Hazar-shual Balah Ezem
verses.literalPt: Hazar-Sual, Balá, Ázem,

verses.original: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּבְת֖וּל וְחָרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el·tō·w·laḏ ū·ḇə·ṯūl wə·ḥā·rə·māh
verses.literal: Eltolad Bethul Hormah
verses.literalPt: Eltolade, Betul, Hormá,

verses.original: וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּבֵית־ הַמַּרְכָּב֖וֹת וַחֲצַ֥ר סוּסָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiq·laḡ ū·ḇêṯ- ham·mar·kā·ḇō·wṯ wa·ḥă·ṣar sū·sāh
verses.literal: Ziklag Beth-marcaboth Hazar-susah
verses.literalPt: Ziclague, Bete-Marcabote, Hazar-Susa,

verses.original: וּבֵ֥ית לְבָא֖וֹת וְשָֽׁרוּחֶ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇêṯ lə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·šā·rū·ḥen ‘ā·rîm šə·lōš- ‘eś·rêh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen thirteen . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: Bete-Lebaote e Saruém; treze cidades com suas aldeias;

verses.original: עַ֥יִן׀ רִמּ֖וֹן וָעֶ֣תֶר וְעָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּ֖ע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘a·yin rim·mō·wn wā·‘e·ṯer wə·‘ā·šān ‘ā·rîm ’ar·ba‘ wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Ain Rimmon Ether and Ashan four cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: Aim, Rimom, Eter e Asã; quatro cidades com suas aldeias;

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַֽחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר סְבִיבוֹת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עַד־ בַּֽעֲלַ֥ת בְּאֵ֖ר רָ֣אמַת נֶ֑גֶב זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ha·ḥă·ṣê·rîm ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ‘aḏ- ba·‘ă·laṯ bə·’êr rā·maṯ ne·ḡeḇ zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- šim·‘ō·wn lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: and all the villages surrounding these cities as far as Baalath-beer Ramah of the Negev This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Simeon
verses.literalPt: e todas as aldeias que estavam ao redor destas cidades até Baalate-Beer, que é Ramá do Neguebe. Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: מֵחֶ֙בֶל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחֲלַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־ הָיָ֞ה חֵ֤לֶק בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָה֙ רַ֣ב מֵהֶ֔ם וַיִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ שִׁמְע֖וֹן בְּת֥וֹךְ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: mê·ḥe·ḇel bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê šim·‘ō·wn kî- hā·yāh ḥê·leq bə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh raḇ mê·hem way·yin·ḥă·lū ḇə·nê- šim·‘ō·wn bə·ṯō·wḵ na·ḥă·lā·ṯām
verses.literal: The inheritance of the Simeonites . . . was taken from the territory of Judah because the share for Judah’s descendants was too large for them So the Simeonites . . . received an inheritance within Judah’s portion
verses.literalPt: Do quinhão dos filhos de Judá tirou-se a herança dos filhos de Simeão, porque a porção que tocou aos filhos de Judá era demais para eles. Portanto, os filhos de Simeão receberam herança no meio da herança deles.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַל֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִבְנֵ֥י זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל נַחֲלָתָ֖ם עַד־ שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al hag·gō·w·rāl haš·šə·lî·šî liḇ·nê zə·ḇū·lun lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām way·hî gə·ḇūl na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ‘aḏ- śā·rîḏ
verses.literal: The third lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Zebulun The border of their inheritance stretched as far as Sarid
verses.literalPt: Surgiu a terceira sorte para os filhos de Zebulom, segundo as suas famílias. Foi o termo da sua herança até Saride;

verses.original: וְעָלָ֨ה גְבוּלָ֧ם׀ לַיָּ֛מָּה וּמַרְעֲלָ֖ה וּפָגַ֣ע בְּדַבָּ֑שֶׁת וּפָגַע֙ אֶל־ הַנַּ֔חַל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י יָקְנְעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·lāh ḡə·ḇū·lām lay·yām·māh ū·mar·‘ă·lāh ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ bə·ḏab·bā·šeṯ ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ ’el- han·na·ḥal ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê yā·qə·nə·‘ām
verses.literal: It went up westward to Maralah reached Dabbesheth and met . . . the brook east . . . of Jokneam
verses.literalPt: subiu para o ocidente, até Maralá, estendeu-se até Dabesete e chegou até a torrente que esta defronte de Jocneão;

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣ב מִשָּׂרִ֗יד קֵ֚דְמָה מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ עַל־ גְּב֥וּל כִּסְלֹ֖ת תָּבֹ֑ר וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־ הַדָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְעָלָ֥ה יָפִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šāḇ miś·śā·rîḏ qê·ḏə·māh miz·raḥ haš·še·meš ‘al- gə·ḇūl kis·lōṯ tā·ḇōr wə·yā·ṣā ’el- had·dā·ḇə·raṯ wə·‘ā·lāh yā·p̄î·a‘
verses.literal: From Sarid it turned eastward . . . . . . along the border of Chisloth-tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia
verses.literalPt: de Saride deu volta para o oriente, para o nascente do sol, até o termo de Quislote-Tabor; estendeu-se até Daberate, e subiu a Jafia;

verses.original: וּמִשָּׁ֤ם עָבַר֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה גִּתָּ֥ה חֵ֖פֶר עִתָּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְיָצָ֛א רִמּ֥וֹן הַמְּתֹאָ֖ר הַנֵּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·šām ‘ā·ḇar qê·ḏə·māh miz·rā·ḥāh git·tāh ḥê·p̄er ‘it·tāh qā·ṣîn wə·yā·ṣā rim·mō·wn ham·mə·ṯō·’ār han·nê·‘āh
verses.literal: From there it crossed eastward . . . to Gath-hepher and to Eth-kazin it extended to Rimmon and curved around toward Neah
verses.literalPt: dali, passou para o oriente, a Gate-Hefer, a Ete-Cazim; chegou a Rimom, que se estende até Neá;

verses.original: וְנָסַ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ הַגְּב֔וּל מִצְּפ֖וֹן חַנָּתֹ֑ן וְהָיוּ֙ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו גֵּ֖י יִפְתַּח־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·saḇ ’ō·ṯōw hag·gə·ḇūl miṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·wn ḥan·nā·ṯōn wə·hā·yū tō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw gê yip̄·taḥ- ’êl
verses.literal: Then the border circled around the north side of Neah to Hannathon and ended . . . at the Valley of Iphtah-el
verses.literalPt: em torno dela, dando volta da banda do norte, a Hanatom, os seus extremos chegaram ao vale de Iftá-El;

verses.original: וְקַטָּ֤ת וְנַֽהֲלָל֙ וְשִׁמְר֔וֹן וְיִדְאֲלָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית לָ֑חֶם עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·na·hă·lāl wə·šim·rō·wn wə·yiḏ·’ă·lāh ū·ḇêṯ lā·ḥem ‘ā·rîm šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: It also included Kattath Nahalal Shimron Idalah and Bethlehem There were twelve . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: Catate, Naalal, Sinrom, Idala e Belém; doze cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ bə·nê- zə·ḇū·lun lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Zebulun including these cities and their villages
verses.literalPt: Esta é a herança dos filhos de Zebulom, segundo as suas famílias, estas cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הָֽרְבִיעִ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār yā·ṣā hag·gō·w·rāl hā·rə·ḇî·‘î liḇ·nê yiś·śā·š·ḵār lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: The fourth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Issachar
verses.literalPt: Saiu a quarta sorte a Issacar, isto é, aos filhos de Issacar, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אלָה וְהַכְּסוּלֹ֖ת וְשׁוּנֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî gə·ḇū·lām yiz·rə·‘e·lāh wə·hak·kə·sū·lōṯ wə·šū·nêm
verses.literal: Their territory included Jezreel Chesulloth Shunem
verses.literalPt: Foi o seu termo até Jezreel, Quesulote, Suném;

verses.original: וַחֲפָרַ֥יִם וְשִׁיאֹ֖ן וַאֲנָחֲרַֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·p̄ā·ra·yim wə·šî·’ōn wa·’ă·nā·ḥă·raṯ
verses.literal: Hapharaim Shion Anaharath
verses.literalPt: Hafaraim, Siom, Anaarate,

verses.original: וְהָֽרַבִּ֥ית וְקִשְׁי֖וֹן וָאָֽבֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rab·bîṯ wə·qiš·yō·wn wā·’ā·ḇeṣ
verses.literal: Rabbith Kishion Ebez
verses.literalPt: Rabite, Quisião, Ebes,

verses.original: וְרֶ֧מֶת וְעֵין־ גַּנִּ֛ים וְעֵ֥ין חַדָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית פַּצֵּֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·re·meṯ wə·‘ên- gan·nîm wə·‘ên ḥad·dāh ū·ḇêṯ paṣ·ṣêṣ
verses.literal: Remeth En-gannim En-haddah and Beth-pazzez
verses.literalPt: Remete, En-Ganim, En-Hadá, Bete-Pazes,

verses.original: וּפָגַע֩ הַגְּב֨וּל בְּתָב֤וֹר וְשַׁחֲצוּמָה וּבֵ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת גְּבוּלָ֖ם הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ hag·gə·ḇūl bə·ṯā·ḇō·wr wə·ša·ḥă·ṣū·må̄h ū·ḇêṯ še·meš wə·hā·yū tō·ṣə·’ō·wṯ gə·ḇū·lām hay·yar·dên ‘ā·rîm šêš- ‘eś·rêh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: The border reached Tabor Shahazumah and Beth-shemesh and ended . . . . . . at the Jordan There were sixteen . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: e, estendendo-se até Tabor, Saazima e Bete-Semes, os seus extremos chegaram ao Jordão; dezesseis cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- yiś·śā·š·ḵār lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Issachar including these cities and their villages
verses.literalPt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, segundo as suas famílias; as cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַֽחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hag·gō·w·rāl ha·ḥă·mî·šî lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ’ā·šêr lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: The fifth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Asher
verses.literalPt: Saiu a quinta sorte à tribo dos filhos de Aser, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם חֶלְקַ֥ת וַחֲלִ֖י וָבֶ֥טֶן וְאַכְשָֽׁף׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî gə·ḇū·lām ḥel·qaṯ wa·ḥă·lî wā·ḇe·ṭen wə·’aḵ·šāp̄
verses.literal: Their territory included Helkath Hali Beten Achshaph
verses.literalPt: Foi o seu termo Helcate, Hali, Béten, Acsafe;

verses.original: וְאַֽלַמֶּ֥לֶךְ וְעַמְעָ֖ד וּמִשְׁאָ֑ל וּפָגַ֤ע בְּכַרְמֶל֙ הַיָּ֔מָּה וּבְשִׁיח֖וֹר לִבְנָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·lam·me·leḵ wə·‘am·‘āḏ ū·miš·’āl ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ bə·ḵar·mel hay·yām·māh ū·ḇə·šî·ḥō·wr liḇ·nāṯ
verses.literal: Allammelech Amad and Mishal On the west the border touched Carmel and Shihor-libnath
verses.literalPt: Alameleque, Amade e Misal; estendeu-se, para o ocidente, até o Carmelo e Sior-Libnate;

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ב מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ֮ בֵּ֣ית דָּגֹן֒ וּפָגַ֣ע בִּ֠זְבֻלוּן וּבְגֵ֨י יִפְתַּח־ אֵ֥ל צָפ֛וֹנָה בֵּ֥ית הָעֵ֖מֶק וּנְעִיאֵ֑ל וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־ כָּב֖וּל מִשְּׂמֹֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šāḇ miz·raḥ haš·še·meš bêṯ dā·ḡōn ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ biz·ḇu·lūn ū·ḇə·ḡê yip̄·taḥ- ’êl ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh bêṯ hā·‘ê·meq ū·nə·‘î·’êl wə·yā·ṣā ’el- kā·ḇūl miś·śə·mōl
verses.literal: then turned eastward . . . toward Beth-dagon touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el and went north to Beth-emek and Neiel passing Cabul on the left
verses.literalPt: deu volta, para o nascente do sol, a Bete-Dagom e chegou até Zebulom, e o vale de Iftá-El da banda do norte, em Bete-Emeque e Neiel; estendeu-se, pela esquerda, até Cabul,

verses.original: וְעֶבְרֹ֥ן וּרְחֹ֖ב וְחַמּ֣וֹן וְקָנָ֑ה עַ֖ד צִיד֥וֹן רַבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘eḇ·rōn ū·rə·ḥōḇ wə·ḥam·mō·wn wə·qā·nāh ‘aḏ ṣî·ḏō·wn rab·bāh
verses.literal: It went on to Ebron Rehob Hammon and Kanah as far as Greater Sidon
verses.literalPt: Ebrom, Reobe, Hamom e Caná, até a grande Sidom;

verses.original: וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ הָֽרָמָ֔ה וְעַד־ עִ֖יר מִבְצַר־ צֹ֑ר וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ חֹסָ֔ה וְיִהְיוּ תֹצְאֹתָ֛יו הַיָּ֖מָּה מֵחֶ֥בֶל אַכְזִֽיבָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šāḇ hag·gə·ḇūl hā·rā·māh wə·‘aḏ- ‘îr miḇ·ṣar- ṣōr wə·šāḇ hag·gə·ḇūl ḥō·sāh wə·yih·yū ṯō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw hay·yām·māh mê·ḥe·ḇel ’aḵ·zî·ḇāh
verses.literal: The border then turned back toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre turned toward Hosah and came out . . . at the Sea in the region of Achzib
verses.literalPt: deu volta a Ramá, e à cidade fortificada de Tiro; e, virando-se para Hosa, os seus extremos chegaram ao mar, na região de Aczibe, …

verses.original: וְעֻמָ֥ה וַאֲפֵ֖ק וּרְחֹ֑ב עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘u·māh wa·’ă·p̄êq ū·rə·ḥōḇ ‘ā·rîm ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·ta·yim wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Ummah Aphek and Rehob There were twenty-two . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: também Umá, Afeca e Reobe; vinte e duas cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ’ā·šêr lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Asher including these cities and their villages
verses.literalPt: Esta é a herança da tribo do filhos de Aser, segundo as suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê nap̄·tā·lî yā·ṣā hag·gō·w·rāl haš·šiš·šî liḇ·nê nap̄·tā·lî lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: The sixth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Naphtali
verses.literalPt: Saiu a sexta sorte aos filhos de Naftali, isto é, aos filhos de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מֵחֵ֨לֶף מֵֽאֵל֜וֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּ֗ים וַאֲדָמִ֥י הַנֶּ֛קֶב וְיַבְנְאֵ֖ל עַד־ לַקּ֑וּם וַיְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḡə·ḇū·lām mê·ḥê·lep̄ mê·’ê·lō·wn bə·ṣa·‘ă·nan·nîm wa·’ă·ḏā·mî han·ne·qeḇ wə·yaḇ·nə·’êl ‘aḏ- laq·qūm way·hî ṯō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Their border started at Heleph and the great tree of Zaanannim passing Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum and ending . . . at the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Foi o seu termo desde Helefe, do terebinto em Zaanim, e Adami-Neguebe e Jabneel, até Lacum; os seus extremos chegaram ao Jordão;

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ב הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֙מָּה֙ אַזְנ֣וֹת תָּב֔וֹר וְיָצָ֥א מִשָּׁ֖ם חוּקֹ֑קָה וּפָגַ֨ע בִּזְבֻל֜וּן מִנֶּ֗גֶב וּבְאָשֵׁר֙ פָּגַ֣ע מִיָּ֔ם וּבִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šāḇ hag·gə·ḇūl yām·māh ’az·nō·wṯ tā·ḇō·wr wə·yā·ṣā miš·šām ḥū·qō·qāh ū·p̄ā·ḡa‘ biz·ḇu·lūn min·ne·ḡeḇ ū·ḇə·’ā·šêr pā·ḡa‘ mî·yām ū·ḇî·hū·ḏāh hay·yar·dên miz·raḥ haš·šā·meš
verses.literal: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and ran from there to Hukkok touching Zebulun on the south side Asher . . . on the west and Judah at the Jordan on the east . . .
verses.literalPt: deu volta, para o ocidente, até Aznote-Tabor e dali se estendeu até Hucoque; chegou a Zebulom, da banda do sul, a Aser, da banda do ocidente e a Judá, junto ao Jordão, para o nascente do sol.

verses.original: וְעָרֵ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר הַצִּדִּ֣ים צֵ֔ר וְחַמַּ֖ת רַקַּ֥ת וְכִנָּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·rê miḇ·ṣār haṣ·ṣid·dîm ṣêr wə·ḥam·maṯ raq·qaṯ wə·ḵin·nā·reṯ
verses.literal: The fortified cities were Ziddim Zer Hammath Rakkath Chinnereth
verses.literalPt: As cidades fortificadas foram Zidim, Zer, Hamate, Racate, e Quinerete,

verses.original: וַאֲדָמָ֥ה וְהָרָמָ֖ה וְחָצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḏā·māh wə·hā·rā·māh wə·ḥā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: Adamah Ramah Hazor
verses.literalPt: Adamá, Ramá, Hazor,

verses.original: וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְאֶדְרֶ֖עִי וְעֵ֥ין חָצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qe·ḏeš wə·’eḏ·re·‘î wə·‘ên ḥā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: Kedesh Edrei En-hazor
verses.literalPt: Quedes, Edrei, En-Hazor,

verses.original: וְיִרְאוֹן֙ וּמִגְדַּל־ אֵ֔ל חֳרֵ֥ם וּבֵית־ עֲנָ֖ת וּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ עָרִ֥ים תְּשַֽׁע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yir·’ō·wn ū·miḡ·dal- ’êl ḥo·rêm ū·ḇêṯ- ‘ă·nāṯ ū·ḇêṯ šā·meš ‘ā·rîm tə·ša‘- ‘eś·rêh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: Iron Migdal-el Horem Beth-anath and Beth-shemesh There were nineteen . . . cities along with their villages
verses.literalPt: Irom, Migdal-El, Horém, Bete-Anate e Bete-Semes; dezenove cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- nap̄·tā·lî lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Naphtali including these cities and their villages
verses.literalPt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias; as cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֥ל הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ḏān lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām yā·ṣā hag·gō·w·rāl haš·šə·ḇî·‘î
verses.literal: The seventh lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Dan
verses.literalPt: Saiu a sétima sorte à tribo dos filhos de Dã, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י גְּב֣וּל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם צָרְעָ֥ה וְאֶשְׁתָּא֖וֹל וְעִ֥יר שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî gə·ḇūl na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ṣā·rə·‘āh wə·’eš·tā·’ō·wl wə·‘îr šā·meš
verses.literal: The territory of their inheritance included Zorah Eshtaol Ir-shemesh
verses.literalPt: Foi o termo da sua herança Zorá, Estaol, Ir-Semes,

verses.original: וְשַֽׁעֲלַבִּ֥ין וְאַיָּל֖וֹן וְיִתְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ša·‘ă·lab·bîn wə·’ay·yā·lō·wn wə·yiṯ·lāh
verses.literal: Shaalabbin Aijalon Ithlah
verses.literalPt: Saalabim, Aijalom, Itla,

verses.original: וְאֵיל֥וֹן וְתִמְנָ֖תָה וְעֶקְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·lō·wn wə·ṯim·nā·ṯāh wə·‘eq·rō·wn
verses.literal: Elon Timnah Ekron
verses.literalPt: Elom, Timna, Ecrom,

verses.original: וְאֶלְתְּקֵ֥ה וְגִבְּת֖וֹן וּבַעֲלָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el·tə·qêh wə·ḡib·bə·ṯō·wn ū·ḇa·‘ă·lāṯ
verses.literal: Eltekeh Gibbethon Baalath
verses.literalPt: Elteque, Gibetom, Baalate,

verses.original: וִיהֻ֥ד וּבְנֵֽי־ בְרַ֖ק וְגַת־ רִמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wî·huḏ ū·ḇə·nê- ḇə·raq wə·ḡaṯ- rim·mō·wn
verses.literal: Jehud Bene-berak Gath-rimmon
verses.literalPt: Jeúde, Bene-Beraque, Gate-Rimom,

verses.original: וּמֵ֥י הַיַּרְק֖וֹן וְהָֽרַקּ֑וֹן עִֽם־ הַגְּב֖וּל מ֥וּל יָפֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê hay·yar·qō·wn wə·hā·raq·qō·wn ‘im- hag·gə·ḇūl mūl yā·p̄ōw
verses.literal: Me-jarkon and Rakkon including the territory across from Joppa
verses.literalPt: Me-Jarcom e Racom, com o termo defronte de Jope.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א גְבוּל־ בְּנֵי־ דָ֖ן מֵהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ דָ֠ן וַיִּלָּחֲמ֨וּ עִם־ לֶ֜שֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּד֥וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ׀ וַיַּכּ֧וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ לְפִי־ חֶ֗רֶב וַיִּֽרְשׁ֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְלֶ֙שֶׁם֙ דָּ֔ן כְּשֵׁ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ḡə·ḇūl- bə·nê- ḏān mê·hem way·ya·‘ă·lū ḇə·nê- ḏān way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū ‘im- le·šem way·yil·kə·ḏū ’ō·w·ṯāh way·yak·kū ’ō·w·ṯāh lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ way·yir·šū ’ō·w·ṯāh way·yê·šə·ḇū ḇāh way·yiq·rə·’ū lə·le·šem dān kə·šêm dān ’ă·ḇî·hem
verses.literal: Later, when the territory of the Danites . . . . . . was lost to them . . . they went up and fought against Leshem captured it and put it to the sword So they took possession of Leshem settled there and renamed it after their father Dan . . .
verses.literalPt: O termo dos filhos de Dã foi ultrapassado, porque os filhos de Dã, subindo, pelejaram contra Lesém e a tomaram; ferindo-a ao fio da espada e apoderando-se dela, a habitaram e chamaram-lhe Dã, do nome de Dã, seu pai.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ḏān lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Dan including these cities and their villages
verses.literalPt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Dã, segundo as suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.

verses.original: וַיְכַלּ֥וּ לִנְחֹל־ אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל נַחֲלָ֛ה לִיהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal·lū lin·ḥōl- ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ liḡ·ḇū·lō·ṯe·hā way·yit·tə·nū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl na·ḥă·lāh lî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: When they had finished distributing the land into its territories the Israelites . . . gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them
verses.literalPt: Acabaram, pois, de repartir a terra em herança pelos seus termos; e os filhos de Israel deram a Josué, filho de Num, herança no meio deles.

verses.original: עַל־ פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה נָ֣תְנוּ ל֗וֹ אֶת־ הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶת־ תִּמְנַת־ סֶ֖רַח בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיִּבְנֶ֥ה אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- pî Yah·weh nā·ṯə·nū lōw ’eṯ- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer šā·’āl ’eṯ- tim·naṯ- se·raḥ bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim way·yiḇ·neh ’eṯ- hā·‘îr way·yê·šeḇ bāh
verses.literal: as the LORD had commanded They gave him the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim as he requested He rebuilt the city and settled in it
verses.literalPt: Segundo a ordem de Jeová, deram-lhe a cidade que ele pediu, a saber, Timnate-Sera, na região montanhosa de Efraim; ele reedificou-a e ali habitou.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַנְּחָלֹ֡ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִחֲל֣וּ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֪עַ בִּן־ נ֟וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֣וֹת לְמַטּוֹת֩ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל׀ בְּגוֹרָ֤ל׀ בְּשִׁלֹה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיְכַלּ֕וּ מֵֽחַלֵּ֖ק אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh han·nə·ḥā·lōṯ ’ă·šer ni·ḥă·lū ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḡō·w·rāl bə·ši·lōh lip̄·nê Yah·weh pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·ḵal·lū mê·ḥal·lêq ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the families distributed by lot to the tribes of Israel at Shiloh before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting So they finished dividing up the land
verses.literalPt: Estas são as heranças que Eleazar, o sacerdote, e Josué, filho de Num, e os cabeças das casas paternas nas tribos dos filhos de Israel repartiram em herança por sorte em Siló, diante de Jeová, à entrada da tenda da revelação. Assim, acabaram de repartir a terra.
